question: Should experimental Claw lifecycle diagnostics remain a core OpenClaw Doctor feature and proceed as part of the stacked Claws ownership rollout?
rationale: The patch is an opt-in feature rather than a repair of an established Doctor contract, crosses lifecycle ownership, state, MCP, and Gateway boundaries, and is explicitly marked for maintainer handling.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded core experiment
options.body: Accept the gated diagnostics as core work, land the prerequisite ownership PR first, and require the small documentation correction before merge.

options.title: Defer the core surface
options.body: Keep this PR open while maintainers decide whether the lifecycle model and diagnostics should instead use a plugin or another extension boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded core experiment
recommendation.body: Accept the gated diagnostics as core work, land the prerequisite ownership PR first, and require the small documentation correction before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline shows direct involvement on the maintainer-labeled PR, making this the best available routing signal for the core-product choice.
